title_ja: Spotify の新しいプレイリスト ノートでは、ユーザーと編集者が自分の選んだ曲を説明できる

title_original: Spotify’s new Playlist Notes let users and editors explain their song picks
summary_en: Spotify announced Monday the launch of “Playlist Notes,” a new feature that lets listeners add their thoughts to the playlists they make.The feature builds on “ User Notes ,” which the streaming giant debuted last month, allowing people to add personal notes to individual tracks.With Playlist Notes, users can add context to songs, podcast episodes, and audiobooks in their playlists.
